fact: The Office of the Prime Minister, through the Department Public Service IT Management, drafted an Interoperability Framework for Namibia modelled on Estonia's X-Road, with stakeholder consultations held in 2016.
Cybernetica states that in 2014 it and the e-Governance Academy introduced in Namibia an interoperability platform and a corresponding framework.
Cybernetica states that in its 2021-2022 capacity building project for the Office of the Prime Minister it helped Namibia update its interoperability framework document.
